Scale of the products I work on. These are product-wide figures, not outcomes attributed to a single feature.

About these numbers +

Source: supplied operational reporting for September 1–28, 2026. All 28 daily observations are included.

Volume: daily counts sum to 552,703 collected samples and 207,375 audited samples. The collected-sample total reconciles with the supplied client totals and excludes internal testing and unmapped/internal organizations. Audit volume follows the supplied Audit CRM reporting scope; it is not presented as a percentage of all collected samples.

Activity: peak daily counts are 1,016 app agents and 271 auditors, both on September 25. Average daily counts over the period are 819.1 app agents, 211.7 auditors, 38.8 Survey Admin Panel users, and 32.4 Operations Management System users. Daily counts are not summed into unique monthly users.
